core_result: Machine-checks 14 zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 theorems (T1a-T3d) spanning Coded/Byzantine PIR (CS-053), Module-LWE reduction tightness (CS-026), and complexity-theoretic barriers around P != NP (CS-001/CS-051). Pillar I (CS-053): resolves the open Schur-product syzygy rank problem of Sun-Tao-Xu-Zhang (arXiv:2603.10769) via shifted-difference Koszul-Veronese moment annihilation over any CommRing with exact Pascal savings K*C(T,T') = lambda* + (K-T')*C(T-1,T'), raising Example VII.A (6,3,3) from 4/7 to 10/17 (T1a); proves K<->T symmetry and universal strict domination over Sun-Zhang (arXiv:2610.37412) LFSR capacity by (K-1)(T-1)E^2 > 0 in both single-file and P-out-of-M multi-file regimes (T1b); establishes Byzantine-robust double-counting converse reduction, exact unrestricted capacity at E=K+1 (breaking E>=KT for all K>=2), and kernel-certifies an explicit F_11 zero-error Byzantine rate-2/5 witness at (M=2,N=6,K=2,T=2,B=1,E=4) with all 90 exact matrix inverses checked without native_decide (T1c); proves sharp flag-privacy thresholds and overlap feasibility Ew <= K*delta*sigma (T1d); kernel-certifies ([propext] alone) a 330-orbit scale-128 pure-integer 12-variable polymatroid h_uncond satisfying all 270,336 elemental Shannon inequalities, 99 PIR equalities (all 89 full T=2 privacy equalities), 1,485 singleton Ingletons, and 3,814,209 retrieval-subsystem Ingletons at 8/13 > 3/5 (T1e); and proves projective P^3 linear impossibility over any SimpleField F (T1f). Pillar II (CS-026): proves determinant-ideal secret independence det(B)=q^m over any CommRing refuting Luo arXiv:2604.15858 (T2a); proves ring-universal anti-periodic DFT even-mode cancellation f_hat(2k)=0 explaining Chen ePrint 2024/555 Step 9 (T2b); certifies FIPS 203 CBD2/CBD3 exact moments, cyclotomic trace-orthogonality, and 60-digit 4.96x Renyi-2 tightness cliff from ML-KEM-512 (7.63 bits) to ML-KEM-1024 (37.84 bits) (T2c); and establishes QGTL shifted-LWE Berry curvature symmetry vanishing at e0=0 and bias witness -512 != 0 at e0=1 (T2d). Pillar III (CS-001/CS-051): formalizes constructive multilinear-extension uniqueness over any field (Algebrization core, T3a), LWE PRF -> Natural Proofs obstruction (T3b), Katz-Trevisan B-Byzantine PIR <-> LDC minimum Hamming distance 2B+1 (T3c), and sharp FIPS 203 Compress_1 margin |e| <= 831 (failing sharply at +832) bounding additive single-server MLWE-PIR depth (T3d). Verified across 6/6 Lean kernels, zero-warning C11 + ASan/UBSan + 512/512 fuzz (40/40 unit tests), Eshkol v1.3.6 dual-number AD (3/3, <2e-13), 14/14 pytest (6/6 core mutants killed), 23/23 live HTTP-200 citations, 100.0% Build Standard v1.2.0 (68/68), and an 11-page 0-overfull AMS-LaTeX preprint + clean-room arXiv tarball.
